page_title: SHU 2-2 EVE | Sheffield Utd v Everton 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+9' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) creates some space for himself near the penalty spot and aims a decent header towards the left side of the goal, but Jordan Pickford leaps and diverts the ball onto the post.
90+9' Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

90+8' Sheffield Utd move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The ball goes out of play. Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 31124.
90+5' It looks like Ben Godfrey (Everton) saw red with that tackle. Andy Madley won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+4' Total attempts – 11:15.
90+3' Sheffield Utd couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Jordan Pickford (Everton) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+1' Substitution. James Tarkowski did his best and is replaced by Ben Godfrey (Everton).
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' James Tarkowski (Everton) is able to continue to play.
89' James Tarkowski (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Ashley Young (Everton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
87' Beto (Everton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
85' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
84' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to release Arnaut Danjuma with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
82' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andy Madley saw the whole situation.
81' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd will take a throw-in.

80' Ashley Young (Everton) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Wesley Foderingham.
78' Amadou Onana (Everton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
76' A rebound falls kindly for Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
75' Paul Heckingbottom prepares a substitution. Cameron Archer is replaced by Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd).
75' That's the end of the game for James Garner, who is replaced by Dwight McNeil (Everton).
74' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
71' Surely that's handball by one of the Everton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Jordan Pickford.
71' Referee Andy Madley signals NO PENALTY for Everton after a VAR review!
70' PENALTY APPEAL by Sheffield Utd, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
70' The ball is cleared after George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
69' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
68' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wesley Foderingham, who smothers the ball.
68' A substitution has been made. John Egan is replaced by Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd).
68' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Yasser Larouci suffers an injury and Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
66' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
66' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' James Garner (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
63' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Andy Madley had a clear view and blows his whistle.
62' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' The total number of attempts is 7:14.
60' The resulting set piece from Sheffield Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

60' The Sheffield Utd players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
59' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
56' The shots on goal statistics – 4:4.

55' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Nathan Patterson. The score is now 2:2.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.

53' Everton are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
52' Amadou Onana (Everton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.
51' Everton are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
51' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
50' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Everton! Play can continue.
49' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
49' Referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Everton. Let’s see what happens!
49' One of the Everton players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 2 - 1 Jordan Pickford (Everton) scores an unfortunate own goal and the opposition increase their lead!

45+3' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
45+3' Everton restart play with a quick free kick.
45+2' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45+2' Nathan Patterson (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
44' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
43' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:2.
42' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
39' A cross into the box from Beto (Everton) is cleared.

37' Ashley Young (Everton) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
36' Amadou Onana (Everton) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Ashley Young (Everton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
35' Beto (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) is teed up on the edge of the box by Oliver McBurnie, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 1:1.
31' The fouls committed statistics – 2:3.

29' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
27' Everton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
27' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) tries to find Cameron Archer, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
26' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It's a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
24' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
23' Sheffield Utd are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
22' A cross from Nathan Patterson (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Sheffield Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

21' A sweet pass finds Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Jordan Pickford is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The linesman makes the right call and Sheffield Utd will have a corner.
20' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Jordan Pickford rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
19' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
18' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

18' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
16' The possession of the ball – 48:52.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
14' Amadou Onana (Everton) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
14' The referee awards a corner and Ashley Young (Everton) goes over to take it.
14' Beto (Everton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
13' Beto (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' This shall not pass! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
11' A pass from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford and the move breaks down.

10' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the left side of the target fails to beat Jordan Pickford, who makes a sensational save.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
8' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
7' Sheffield Utd take a short corner kick.
6' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' James Garner (Everton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
5' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
4' Nathan Patterson (Everton) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call.
4' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Nathan Patterson (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
2' Nathan Patterson (Everton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' James Garner (Everton) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
1' Andy Madley blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) brought his opponent down. Everton are awarded the free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Everton will kick-off.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
